What it does

FreshBooks is invoicing and basic accounting without the weight of a full accounting suite. For an owner-operator who wants to send professional invoices, track time and get paid online, it is easier to live with than QuickBooks. It is less suited to construction work, where job costing and progress billing matter more than simple invoicing.

Where the AI actually is

Light AI assistance for expense categorisation and reminders.

Pros

  • Easy invoicing and time tracking
  • Client portal for approvals and payment
  • Less intimidating than full accounting suites

Cons

  • Limited job costing for construction work

Who it suits

Built with Landscapers, Remodelers & carpenters, Plumbers in mind. Owner-operators who want invoicing without an accounting degree.
